title: 168-170 Latta Avenue (Houses), Columbus, Franklin County, OH
notes: Significance: A single family residence that was later converted to a two family residence, the house contributes to the Neat East Side Historic District. Predominately residential area was developed in the late 1800s for the upper middle and upper classes. It remained fashionable until the 1930s.
National Register of Historic Places NRIS Number: 78002063
